name: Profile and account deletion
summary: Managing your own profile and password, and deleting your account.

roles.note: Every verified user can manage their own profile, including users with no project role (USER-REQ-021).

nfr.statement: How long a deleted user's retained identity and audit records are kept.
nfr.open_question: What retention period applies, and does any customer contract or law require full erasure (DEC-015)?

requirements.title: Users manage their own profile
requirements.statement: In their profile, users can update their personal information, change their password and log out.

acceptance_criteria.then: They can update their details, change their password and log out

requirements.title: Deleting an account anonymises it but keeps an audit record
requirements.statement: When users delete their own account, their name, email and status are replaced, all sessions are revoked and all role assignments are removed. The original identity is kept in a deleted-user record, so this is not full erasure.

acceptance_criteria.given: A user assigned to two projects
acceptance_criteria.then: They can no longer sign in, they appear on neither project, and their original identity exists only in the deleted-user record
